facts.fact: India's Ministry of External Affairs says Ooru Digital is implementing a MOSIP-based National Digital Identity system and a National Citizen Portal for São Tomé and Príncipe, enabling access to public services through National ID-based login, and that the portal was launched on 27 March 2026.

note: Document covers an automatic voter registration platform and civil registry equipment; no ID system, number or link to one is stated.

Digital identity transition announced; no authentication, e-signature or PKI service is stated.

facts.fact: The registry and notary directorate is running a pilot of a digital identity platform, for which it sought 1,000 volunteer testers.

Ooru Digital, the implementer, says e-Authentication services and digital signatures for São Tomé and Príncipe are in Phase 3 (2026) of a programme in active implementation with DGRN and INIC, to let citizens identify themselves online.
